template<class F> OcctSharp_Status Guard(F&& call) {
  OcctSharp_Internal_SetLastError("");
  try { call(); return OCCTSHARP_STATUS_SUCCESS; }
  catch (const OcctSharpGenerated::GeneratedOperationFailure& e) { OcctSharp_Internal_SetLastError(e.what()); return e.Status; }
  catch (const Standard_Failure& e) { OcctSharp_Internal_SetLastError(e.GetMessageString()); return OCCTSHARP_STATUS_OCCT_FAILURE; }
  catch (const std::exception& e) { OcctSharp_Internal_SetLastError(e.what()); return OCCTSHARP_STATUS_STANDARD_EXCEPTION; }
  catch (...) { OcctSharp_Internal_SetLastError("Unknown copied collection exception."); return OCCTSHARP_STATUS_UNKNOWN_EXCEPTION; }
}
inline void Require(bool valid, const char* message) {
  if (!valid) throw OcctSharpGenerated::GeneratedOperationFailure(OCCTSHARP_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, message);
}
inline void Bounds(int lower, int count, bool sequence) {
  Require(count >= (sequence ? 0 : 1), "Invalid copied collection count.");
  // Array1::Upper computes lower + size before subtracting one. Kernel loops
  // also increment/decrement endpoint indices; reserve both signed endpoints.
  Require(sequence ? lower == 1 : lower > std::numeric_limits<int>::min()
    && static_cast<int64_t>(lower) + count <= std::numeric_limits<int>::max(), "Copied collection bounds exceed safe kernel indices.");
}
template<class T> void Ascending(const NCollection_Array1<T>& values, bool strict) {
  for (int i = 1; i < values.Length(); ++i)
    Require(strict ? values.Value(values.Lower()+i-1) < values.Value(values.Lower()+i)
                   : values.Value(values.Lower()+i-1) <= values.Value(values.Lower()+i), "Collection must be ordered.");
}
template<class T> void Minimum(const NCollection_Array1<T>& values, int count) {
  Require(values.Length() >= count, "Insufficient collection elements.");
}
template<class T, class U> void SameBounds(const NCollection_Array1<T>& a, const NCollection_Array1<U>& b) {
  Require(a.Lower() == b.Lower() && a.Length() == b.Length(), "Collection bounds do not match.");
}
// A registration is rolled back if any subsequent publication fails.
template<class T> class Publication {
  void* token;
public:
  explicit Publication(std::shared_ptr<T> value) : token(OcctSharpOwned::Register(std::move(value), typeid(T))) {}
  ~Publication() { if (token) OcctSharpOwned::Release(token, typeid(T)); }
  void* Commit() noexcept { auto* result = token; token = nullptr; return result; }
};
